first_step_test: The first saved crop has one recognizable arched mailbox with its connected front door and round pull in final position; a beginner can copy its broad side then close the front before adding attachments.

source.notes: Five substantive states selected as whole raster cells from the second generated six-cell sheet; first sheet rejected for row drift and extra preliminary cell of second sheet omitted because it made a redundant step. Original sheets remain private.

final_elements.name: arched body and front door
final_elements.description: One long right-facing rounded mailbox body, narrow attached arched door face, and one round pull.

final_elements.name: support post
final_elements.description: One short straight post centered under the body with a flat base.

final_elements.name: raised flag
final_elements.description: One narrow raised rectangular flag attached by a bent stem to a circular hinge at the upper-left side of the box.

final_elements.name: envelope emblem and shadow
final_elements.description: One rectangle with V-shaped envelope flap on the box side and broken ground marks below the post.

visual_review.first_step_observation: The first saved crop presents one long arched body, attached narrow right door and round pull. These fixed contours establish the whole silhouette and leave open paper below for its support post.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: Five saved crops were inspected in order. The arched right-facing box, narrow door and pull persist while one center post, one raised left flag, one envelope emblem and broken ground appear. The finish fills only established contours with streaky cobalt, coral, yellow and gray marker. No temporary guides or unexplained structural removal appears.
